resolution: Camera-angle trace so the user can show the jump. On every drag move event the viewport logs (console.warn, so it reaches the dev terminal — console.log severity 0 stays in the in-memory ring) a [studio-cam] line with the COMMANDED yaw/pitch, the per-event delta (dyaw/dpitch), the raw dx/dy, and the inter-event gap in ms. In one smooth physical drag a large gap paired with a large dyaw between events means input is arriving in bursts (the camera 'jumps' because events batch), which reads differently from a host present stall (the frame readout from req_0963 catches that). The trace is opt-in via a 'log cam' toggle in the viewport corner (default on for now so the user can capture it immediately). Data-gathering only — no fix to the orbit yet; the log + frame readout together will tell us whether the jump is bursty input or host smoothing/present. Bundle-clean, hot-reloadable.
